newsitem.title: USA: Chino copper talks end without deal - Phelps.
newsitem.headline: Chino copper talks end without deal - Phelps.

text.p: Talks between Phelps Dodge Corp and the United Steelworkers of America union on Thursday and Friday last week ended without agreement on a new labor deal for workers at the Chino copper mine, the company's Treasurer, Tom Foster said.
"We are at an impasse," Foster said. "No meetings are scheduled and the mine is operating fine."
Union officials were not immediately available for comment.
Workers at Chino in New Mexico, which produces some 160,000 tons per year of contained copper, have been without a labor contract since June 30 last year.
Union officials have asked for a pay hike, but the company's final offer would freeze wages.
"The union is still not taking it (the final offer) to the employees for a vote," Foster said.
